title: Mass Manipulation
description: Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

puzzle.goal: A free scalar field φ describes a particle of mass m. Make the wave equation consistent with relativity by turning E² = p²c² + m²c⁴ into derivatives (E → iħ∂/∂t, p → −iħ∇). Write the second time derivative, divided by c², in terms of the three spatial second derivatives and the mass term.
puzzle.name: Klein–Gordon equation (relativistic energy–momentum relation)
puzzle.form: pd2 ( φ , x ) + pd2 ( φ , y ) + pd2 ( φ , z ) - m ^ 2 * c ^ 2 / ħ ^ 2 * φ
puzzle.ask: A plane wave solves it when E² = p²c² + m²c⁴. Find E (GeV) for p = 3 GeV/c and m = 4 GeV/c² in units with c = 1 (set m = 0 to see massless matter).
puzzle.method: Square the energy operator and the momentum operator, apply both to φ, and rearrange; ∇² splits into three second partial derivatives.
